# External data sources

Vendored, third-party data used to compute AI-exposure scores (F5). Not
generated by this project — see citations below for provenance and reuse
terms.

## `occ_level.csv`, `national_May2021_dl.csv`

- **Source**: Eloundou, T., Manning, S., Mishkin, P., & Rock, D. (2024).
  "GPTs are GPTs: Labor market impact potential of LLMs." *Science*,
  384(6702), 1306–1308. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adj0998
- **Data + code**: https://github.com/openai/GPTs-are-GPTs
- **License**: MIT (confirmed via `LICENSE` file in the source repo,
  2026-08-09).
- `occ_level.csv`: O*NET-SOC-level LLM exposure ratings. Columns used by
  this project: `O*NET-SOC Code`, `dv_rating_beta` (GPT-4-rated exposure
  including tasks reducible with complementary software — the paper's
  headline "LLM + software" measure, 0–1 scale).
- `national_May2021_dl.csv`: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage
  Statistics (OEWS), May 2021, national cross-industry estimates. Used for
  `TOT_EMP` (total employment) as the weighting variable when a single COD
  occupation maps to multiple SOC/O*NET-SOC codes. Re-vendored from the same
  MIT-licensed repo rather than pulled separately from BLS; underlying data
  is itself a U.S. government work (public domain).

## `isco08_to_soc2010.csv`

- **Source**: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, on behalf of the Standard
  Occupational Classification Policy Committee (SOCPC). "ISCO-08 x SOC 2010
  Crosswalk." August 2012 (updated June 2015).
  https://www.bls.gov/soc/isco_soc_crosswalk.xls
- **License**: U.S. government work — public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105).
- **Provenance note**: `bls.gov` blocks automated/scripted downloads
  (returns an "Access Denied" bot-detection page to `curl`). Retrieved
  instead via the Wayback Machine archive of the same URL
  (`web.archive.org/web/20260613143254/https://www.bls.gov/soc/ISCO_SOC_Crosswalk.xls`),
  verified as the genuine BLS file via its embedded document metadata
  (Title: "ISCO-08 x SOC 2010 Crosswalk", Author: "U.S. Bureau of Labor
  Statistics"). Original file format (`.xls`) converted to CSV losslessly;
  no data values altered, only container format.
- Maps ISCO-08 4-digit unit-group codes to 2010 SOC 6-digit detailed
  occupation codes. `scripts/reference/cod_estrutura.json`'s COD codes are
  themselves ISCO-08 codes (see `tasks/plan.md`'s "Correção importante"
  note).

## `soc2010_to_soc2018.csv`

- **Source**: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, on behalf of OMB and the
  Standard Occupational Classification Policy Committee (SOCPC).
  "Crosswalk between 2010 SOC and 2018 SOC." November 2017.
  https://www.bls.gov/soc/2018/soc_2010_to_2018_crosswalk.xlsx
- **License**: U.S. government work — public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105).
- **Provenance note**: same bot-blocking issue as the ISCO-08 crosswalk
  above; retrieved via a Wayback Machine snapshot, verified genuine via the
  embedded document header ("U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics... on behalf of
  the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) and the Standard Occupational
  Classification Policy Committee (SOCPC)").
- **Why needed**: `occ_level.csv` (Eloundou et al.) and
  `national_May2021_dl.csv` (BLS OEWS, May 2021) both use **2018 SOC**
  codes, but the ISCO-08 crosswalk above is keyed to **2010 SOC**. The two
  vintages differ materially for several detailed occupations — e.g. 2010's
  separate "Software Developers, Applications" (15-1132) and "Software
  Developers, Systems Software" (15-1133) were merged into a single 2018
  code "Software Developers" (15-1252). Without this second hop, COD
  occupations mapping to since-renamed 2010 codes (software developers,
  physicians by specialty, and others) would silently get zero exposure
  coverage. `scripts/build_cod_to_soc_crosswalk.py` chains ISCO-08 → SOC2010
  → SOC2018, so `cod_to_soc.json` stores ready-to-join 2018 SOC codes.

## `br-uf.json`

- **Source**: IBGE (Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística). Malha territorial brasileira, subdivisão por Unidades da Federação (UF), formato GeoJSON.
- **Fetch URL**: `https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/malhas/paises/BR?intrarregiao=UF&qualidade=minima&formato=application/vnd.geo+json`
- **Fetch date**: 2026-08-11
- **License**: Decreto 8.777/2016 (Dados Abertos)

## `pnadc_layout.json`

- **Source**: IBGE (Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística). Dicionário de variáveis e input SAS dos microdados trimestrais da PNAD Contínua.
- **Fetch URL**: `https://ftp.ibge.gov.br/Trabalho_e_Rendimento/Pesquisa_Nacional_por_Amostra_de_Domicilios_continua/Trimestral/Microdados/Documentacao/Dicionario_e_input_20221031.zip`
- **License**: Decreto 8.777/2016 (Dados Abertos)
- **Provenance note**: Extracted programmatically via `scripts/fetch_pnad_layout.py` which parses the `input_PNADC_trimestral.sas` program to extract 0-indexed column slices for our variables of interest.
